title: Category 2 test 1 (no-car roads): owner decisions
why: Owner, 17 Oct 2026: (1) any route from any engine or service (TomTom, OSRM, Valhalla, DMN) that uses a bus gate, busway or other no-car road is marked FAIL, in test results and by the app's check of received routes; (2) time-limited bus gates evaluated against the clock (implement later); (3) when the only route is through a bus gate, say so on screen (implement later).
